_help: A seed registry of curated starter contracts for common stacks — hosted in this repo, no separate infra required. Point loophole at it with: loophole registry add-source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chuzom/loophole/main/registry/index.json — then `loophole run --contract fastapi` (etc.) resolves one of these by name. Contributions of new stacks welcome; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
